description:
You’re going to die.
We all are.
So why are you wasting time worrying about opinions, fear of failure, or playing it safe?

So if you knew you were going to die tonight…
What would matter right now?

👉 If you want a direct link to listen to The Mindset Mentor Podcast comment "LISTEN NOW" below and I'll message it to you now!
transcript: you're going to fucking die. Why are you worried about all of the shit that you worry about? Like you're on a rock spinning a thousand miles an hour in the middle of two trillion galaxies, and you're worrying about what other people think about you or worrying about if you're going to fail. Like what if you knew that you weren't going to wake up tomorrow? If you were going to die tonight, would you still be focusing on all of this dumb stuff that you focus on? How would that change what you do today? Think about this. And I mean, like, really think about it and let that dictate your next action and what you focus on.
